near_zero_method.measured: For each kind/unit, max abs(observed-recorded) over exact-zero recorded references; this is the direct absolute-floor boundary measurement.
near_zero_method.nearest_nonzero_context: Also report the smallest absolute nonzero recorded reference and its delta. No scale sweep was available, so this is context, not a measured positive floor.
